notes: Andrew, 2026-11-10, with a screenshot of an Amazon listing (a camel chenille bench at the foot of a bed, on a pale gray-ivory rug that runs under the lower part of the bed): "I want an end of bed ottoman and a rug in the style here (i.e. coving a part of the end of the bed and the ottoman). Be mindful: radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed. show me layout in browser. Use amazon only for searches. Be a interior designer, make sure color,lenght etc work" IKEA sells three RÅDMANSÖ dressers in brown walnut effect, all 18 7/8" deep: the 6-drawer (ikea-40593839, 62 5/8" wide, 31 7/8" tall, $349.99), the 3-drawer (ikea-80593837, 35 3/8" wide, 31 3/4" tall, $229.99) and the 5-drawer (ikea-60593838, 27 1/2" wide, 52" tall, $299.99). Which one Andrew means isn't said: the 6-drawer is staged, and the depth, which sets every clearance in front of it, is the same for all three. IKEA was opened only to read these (his words: "Use amazon only for searches"). Not staged: a tall chest, 52", reads as a column opposite the bed rather than a low line; if this is the one, it stands on the same wall with an anchor. Article 605.938.38; 4.5 stars; the page says "Designed to meet the US Federal Stability Standard". In stock at IKEA Long Island, NY; home delivery to 11364 from $29.00 (as read). Flags: anchor-required (F-21: 52" tall).
